```{r}
# install.packages(c("magick", "glue"))
library(grid)
library(glue)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

# ---------- helper to draw one frame ----------

draw_cv_frame <- function(stage = 1) {

  # colours
  text_col      <- "#22313F"
  train_fill    <- "#DCE7ED"
  train_border  <- "#7A8C9C"
  test_fill     <- "#F3B562"
  test_border   <- "#B06E27"
  inactive_fill <- "#F7F9FB"
  inactive_border <- "#D6DDE3"
  line_col      <- "#4B5D73"

  # canvas
  grid.newpage()
  pushViewport(viewport(xscale = c(0, 1), yscale = c(0, 1)))

  # title
  grid.text(
    "5-fold cross-validation",
    x = 0.5, y = 0.95,
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 22, fontface = "bold", col = text_col)
  )

  grid.text(
    "Fit the regression on 4 folds, test it on the held-out fold, then average the prediction errors.",
    x = 0.5, y = 0.90,
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, col = text_col)
  )

  # layout parameters
  left <- 0.18
  top <- 0.78
  cell_w <- 0.09
  cell_h <- 0.06
  col_gap <- 0.018
  row_gap <- 0.04

  nrow <- 5
  ncol <- 5

  cell_x <- function(c) left + (c - 1) * (cell_w + col_gap)
  cell_y <- function(r) top  - (r - 1) * (cell_h + row_gap)

  # column labels
  for (c in 1:ncol) {
    grid.text(
      paste("Fold", c),
      x = cell_x(c) + cell_w / 2,
      y = top + 0.045,
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold", col = text_col)
    )
  }

  # row labels
  for (r in 1:nrow) {
    grid.text(
      paste("Sub-Model", r),
      x = left - 0.02,
      y = cell_y(r) + cell_h / 2,
      just = "right",
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold", col = text_col)
    )
  }

  # draw cells
  for (r in 1:nrow) {
    active <- r <= min(stage, 5)

    for (c in 1:ncol) {
      x <- cell_x(c)
      y <- cell_y(r)

      if (active) {
        if (c == r) {
          fill <- test_fill
          border <- test_border
          label <- "TEST"
          face <- "bold"
        } else {
          fill <- train_fill
          border <- train_border
          label <- "train"
          face <- "plain"
        }
      } else {
        fill <- inactive_fill
        border <- inactive_border
        label <- NULL
        face <- "plain"
      }

      grid.roundrect(
        x = x, y = y,
        width = cell_w, height = cell_h,
        just = c("left", "bottom"),
        r = unit(0.006, "snpc"),
        gp = gpar(fill = fill, col = border, lwd = 1.5)
      )

      if (!is.null(label)) {
        grid.text(
          label,
          x = x + cell_w / 2,
          y = y + cell_h / 2,
          gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = face, col = text_col)
        )
      }
    }

    # arrows and RMSE labels
    if (active) {
      ymid <- cell_y(r) + cell_h / 2
      x1 <- cell_x(5) + cell_w + 0.015
      x2 <- x1 + 0.045

      grid.lines(
        x = c(x1, x2), y = c(ymid, ymid),
        gp = gpar(col = line_col, lwd = 2)
      )
      grid.polygon(
        x = c(x2, x2 - 0.008, x2 - 0.008),
        y = c(ymid, ymid + 0.006, ymid - 0.006),
        gp = gpar(fill = line_col, col = line_col)
      )
      grid.text(
        paste0("RMSE", r),
        x = x2 + 0.04, y = ymid,
        just = "left",
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, col = text_col)
      )
    }
  }

  # bottom explanation
  if (stage <= 5) {
    grid.text(
      glue("Round {stage}: hold out Fold {stage}, fit on the other 4 folds, and compute RMSE{stage}."),
      x = 0.5, y = 0.16,
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, col = text_col)
    )
  } else {
    # extra line on right, just to suggest averaging
    grid.lines(
      x = c(0.77, 0.90), y = c(0.26, 0.26),
      gp = gpar(col = line_col, lwd = 1.5)
    )

    grid.text(
      "CV error = average(RMSE1, RMSE2, RMSE3, RMSE4, RMSE5)",
      x = 0.5, y = 0.18,
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold", col = text_col)
    )
    grid.text(
      "Each observation is tested once, but never on a model trained on itself.",
      x = 0.5, y = 0.12,
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, col = text_col)
    )
  }

  # legend
  legend_y <- 0.05

  grid.roundrect(
    x = 0.12, y = legend_y,
    width = 0.02, height = 0.035,
    just = c("left", "bottom"),
    r = unit(0.004, "snpc"),
    gp = gpar(fill = train_fill, col = train_border, lwd = 1.2)
  )
  grid.text(
    "used to fit model",
    x = 0.145, y = legend_y + 0.0175,
    just = "left",
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, col = text_col)
  )

  grid.roundrect(
    x = 0.35, y = legend_y,
    width = 0.02, height = 0.035,
    just = c("left", "bottom"),
    r = unit(0.004, "snpc"),
    gp = gpar(fill = test_fill, col = test_border, lwd = 1.2)
  )
  grid.text(
    "held out for validation",
    x = 0.375, y = legend_y + 0.0175,
    just = "left",
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, col = text_col)
  )

  popViewport()
}

# Replay the completed grid scene before closing the device. This keeps the
# first frame from being partially flushed by the graphics device.
render_cv_frame <- function(stage) {
  draw_cv_frame(stage)
  frame <- grid.grab()
  grid.newpage()
  grid.draw(frame)
}

# ---------- write temporary PNG frames and build the GIF ----------

make_cv_gif <- function(output_file) {
  if (!requireNamespace("magick", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("This document needs the 'magick' package. Install it with install.packages('magick').")
  }

  frame_dir <- tempfile("cv_frames_")
  dir.create(frame_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  on.exit(unlink(frame_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE), add = TRUE)

  png_files <- file.path(frame_dir, sprintf("cv_frame_%02d.png", 1:6))

  for (i in seq_along(png_files)) {
    grDevices::png(
      filename = png_files[i],
      width = 1200,
      height = 620,
      res = 120,
      bg = "transparent"
    )
    tryCatch(
      render_cv_frame(i),
      finally = grDevices::dev.off()
    )
  }

  frames <- magick::image_read(png_files)

  # Hold the completed diagram for two seconds before looping.
  frames <- c(frames, frames[6])
  gif <- magick::image_animate(frames, fps = 1, loop = 0)
  magick::image_write(gif, path = output_file)

  invisible(output_file)
}

make_cv_diagram <- function(output_file) {
  cv_steps <- tibble(
    x = c(1, 3, 5, 7),
    label = c("Fit on\ntraining data", "Predict\nheld-out data", "Measure\nprediction error", "Repeat\nwith new folds")
  )

  diagram <- ggplot(cv_steps, aes(x = x, y = 0)) +
    geom_segment(
      data = tibble(x = c(1.70, 3.70, 5.70), xend = c(2.30, 4.30, 6.30)),
      aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = 0, yend = 0),
      arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.12, "inches")),
      colour = "#325d88", linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_label(
      aes(label = label),
      fill = "#f8f5f0", colour = "#3e3f3a", label.size = 0.4,
      size = 3.5, lineheight = 0.9
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.4, 7.6), ylim = c(-0.7, 0.8), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
    )

  svglite::svglite(output_file, width = 8, height = 1.2, bg = "transparent")
  print(diagram)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  invisible(output_file)
}

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
document_dir <- if (is.null(input_file) || !nzchar(input_file)) {
  getwd()
} else {
  dirname(input_file)
}
resources_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(document_dir, "..", "resources"), mustWork = TRUE)
gif_file <- file.path(resources_dir, "cv_5fold.gif")
svg_file <- file.path(resources_dir, "cv_basic.svg")
make_cv_gif(gif_file)
make_cv_diagram(svg_file)
invisible(c(gif_file, svg_file))
```

knitr::include_graphics(gif_file)
